I've written the sign-up flow to `./solution.tsx`, but I couldn't run it, so it hasn't been tried in a browser.

It uses the kit's Card, Field, Input, Radio, Checkbox and Button, with spacing and colour taken from the brand variables so it follows all three brands.

- **Step 1:** "Step 1 of 3" and "Your details". "Continue" shows "Enter your name." or "Enter a valid email." next to the field and stays on the step until both are fixed. A name of only spaces counts as empty.
- **Step 2:** "Your team" has the three options as radios, with "Back" and "Continue". I preselected "Solo" so exactly one option is always chosen.
